_notes.num_fourier_features: Larger → denser Θ, more expressive but slower fit and more memory. 1000–5000 is typical.
_notes.coeff_std: Controls RFF frequency bandwidth. Match to the expected spectral content of the residual.
_notes.sindy_threshold: Main sparsity knob. Set just above the noise floor of |Ξ| magnitudes.
_notes.sindy_alpha: Ridge regularisation for STLSQ. Increase if Θ is ill-conditioned.
_notes.sindy_nu: SR3 relaxation. Smaller → more aggressive sparsity.
_notes.max_samples: Cap dataset size for memory/speed. null = use all.
